values.AssociatedLNGNotes: Enbridge agreed in January 2022 to expand the Valley Crossing Pipeline to deliver about 720 million cubic feet per day to Texas LNG's export facility in Brownsville, under a 20-year precedent agreement, according to a report from the Energy Job Shop repeating a PG Online article.

verifications.note: The page says Texas LNG Brownsville and Enbridge signed a precedent agreement to expand the Valley Crossing Pipeline to deliver about 720 million cubic feet per day to Texas LNG's export facility for at least 20 years.

records.researcher_notes: The Valley Crossing expansion is the 720 million cubic feet per day capacity line on the sheet. The newest source found is the January 2022 agreement, so the project status is not confirmed past 2022. Terminal name taken from the terminal list.
